permissions.name: View the programmes one is given access to
permissions.description: Programmes, their results frameworks and indicators, for the programmes a manager has opened to this person.

permissions.name: Work on every programme
permissions.description: Reaches every programme of the organization without being given access to each one. For M&E staff.

permissions.name: Set up programmes
permissions.description: Programmes, reporting units, reporting periods, who has access to each programme, and archiving.

permissions.name: Link reporting units to Projects
permissions.description: Connects a reporting unit to a project kept in Miles Projects. Projects stays the record of the project.

permissions.name: Set up results frameworks and indicators
permissions.description: Results, indicators and their definitions, baselines and targets.

permissions.name: Enter and submit results
permissions.description: Actual values and evidence for the programmes and units one has access to.

permissions.name: View drafts and submitted results
permissions.description: Everything entered, at every stage, for the programmes one has access to.

permissions.name: Verify or reject submitted results
permissions.description: Never one's own submission, unless the organization allows it in settings.

permissions.name: Publish verified results
permissions.description: Published results are what donors and reports outside the organization see.

permissions.name: View verified results and their evidence
permissions.description: For independent evaluators: verified and published results with all their evidence, no drafts.

permissions.name: View published results
permissions.description: Published results and the evidence marked as shareable, for the programmes and periods one is given access to.

permissions.name: View reports
permissions.description: At the level of results the person may see (published, verified or all).

permissions.name: Change M&E settings
permissions.description: Locations, implementing partners, disaggregation dimensions, review rules and performance thresholds.

permissions.name: View survey forms and collected data
permissions.description: Forms, their versions and the submissions collected with them, for the programmes and forms one reaches. Personal answers stay hidden without the personal data permission.

permissions.name: Design survey forms
permissions.description: Create, edit, duplicate and preview survey forms.

permissions.name: Publish survey forms
permissions.description: Publish new versions, close old ones and archive forms.

permissions.name: Assign field data collectors
permissions.description: Choose who collects with which form, and close or revoke their assignments.

permissions.name: Collect data in the field
permissions.description: Download the forms one is assigned and send submissions from the field app.

permissions.name: Review collected data
permissions.description: Accept or reject submissions, and ask their collector for corrections.

permissions.name: Correct collected data
permissions.description: Record a correction to a submission, with its reason. The original answers are kept.

permissions.name: Export collected data
permissions.description: Download submissions as CSV or Excel files.

permissions.name: See respondents' personal data
permissions.description: Answers marked personal (names, phone numbers, identity numbers), photos and exact locations, on screen and in exports.

roles.name: M&E administrator
roles.description: Everything in M&E, including settings and the audit trail.

roles.name: M&E manager
roles.description: Sets up programmes, frameworks and indicators, verifies and publishes results.

roles.name: M&E officer
roles.description: Enters, imports and reviews results across programmes. Cannot publish.

roles.name: Field officer
roles.description: Enters and submits results for the programmes and units they are given.

roles.name: Enumerator
roles.description: Collects data in the field with the forms they are assigned, from the field app. Sees nothing else.

roles.name: Project manager
roles.description: Follows the results of the programmes they are given, and links them to their projects.

roles.name: Implementing partner
roles.description: Enters and submits results for their own units of the programmes they are given.

roles.name: Donor viewer
roles.description: Sees published results and shareable evidence for the programmes and periods they are given. Nothing internal.

roles.name: Independent evaluator
roles.description: Reads verified and published results with their evidence for the programmes and periods they are given. Changes nothing.

separation_of_duties.description: M&E refuses verification by whoever submitted the result (unless settings allow it); one person holding both still removes a check when nobody else does.
Settings can require that whoever verified a result does not also publish it.
M&E refuses a review by whoever collected the submission (unless settings allow it); one person holding both still removes a check when nobody else does.
